description: Structured output produced by the LLM. Every field is required so the schema can be strict.

urgency_reason.description: One or two sentences citing the evidence for the urgency.
urgency_reason.title: Urgency Reason

product_area.description: Product area affected, e.g. 'billing/checkout', 'web app', 'appearance settings'.
product_area.title: Product Area

issue_types.description: All issue types present in the thread, most important first.
issue_types.title: Issue Types

sentiment.description: Customer sentiment in the latest message.

sentiment_trend.description: How sentiment changed across the thread.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the customer's language, e.g. 'en', 'th'.
language.title: Language

key_facts.description: Concrete facts an agent needs: amounts, errors, deadlines, scope of impact.
key_facts.title: Key Facts

kb_article_ids.description: IDs of knowledge-base articles actually used. Empty if none were relevant.
kb_article_ids.title: Kb Article Ids

route_to.description: Team that should own the ticket. Null only for auto_respond.

customer_reply.description: Draft reply to the customer, in the customer's language, grounded in tool/KB results.
customer_reply.title: Customer Reply

internal_note.description: Short hand-off note for the support team.
internal_note.title: Internal Note

title: TriageDecision
